brief: Top Pick: Build an 'AI Gateway' aggregator to unify 500+ models; developers are desperate for a single API abstraction to swap providers instantly.
Opportunity: Leverage 'Graphify' to build an automated codebase-to-knowledge-graph engine for enterprise-grade AI coding assistants.
Breakout Timing: Agentic frameworks (Superpowers, Orca) are hitting maturity—now is the time to build the 'OS' layer that manages parallel agent workflows.
Niche Play: Use 'RuView' spatial intelligence to build privacy-first, non-camera presence detection for smart office automation.
